name: Dr. Yuki Mensah-Solomon
description:
Yuki runs the salon. The salon does not have a name on the door. There is no door. The salon is six rooms in a sub-tier basement under a former municipal water-treatment facility in the GLMZ northern outskirts, accessible by a passage Yuki rebuilt herself in 2218 and which she has not authorized any architectural survey of. Inside the salon she does genemod work at a quality the corponation clinics three tiers up cannot match at any price. Outside the salon she is a freelance medic Kyle has called four times when the night was bad enough.

The quality of her work is the question nobody on the street wants to answer. The answer, which Yuki has not advertised, is that her materials come from an ELF (cross-reference: project_glmz_mysteries, ELFs section). The ELF — name not yet established in canon — fixed her supply chain in 2219 in exchange for things Yuki has not fully described and which Kyle has not asked about. The arrangement has continued for six years. Yuki is one of three freelancers in the GLMZ corridor who currently have a working relationship with an ELF and who can confirm the ELF's continued existence to other operators who need to know.
heritage: Ghanaian-Japanese-Jewish. Father's family from Accra via the West African medical-school diaspora. Mother's family is half Osaka, half Tel Aviv via three generations of medical-research migration. Yuki is fluent in Twi, Japanese, Hebrew, English, and a working dialect of Mandarin she picked up in residency.
specialty: genetic modification surgery (medical and cosmetic and functional); cybernetic implant maintenance and removal; emergency trauma; ELF-supply-chain procurement of materials that are not, strictly, available through corponation channels
method: works in her salon when the work can be brought to her; runs a mobile rig for emergency contracts she takes in the field. Does not bill in Φ; bills in a barter system she has developed over fifteen years that takes the form of favors, materials, and (rarely) currency.
code: the patient owns the patient's body; the procedure has to be one the patient consented to with the full information the patient was capable of receiving; she does not work on the unconscious unless the unconscious is an emergency stabilization and a witness can sign for them. She has refused three corponation contracts in the past two years on the grounds that the consent paperwork was theatre. Each refusal cost her business. None of them cost her her practice.
signature_gear: the salon itself; a portable autodoc she built from three different manufacturers' components and tunes herself; a set of genemod-injection tools she had custom-fabricated by a Helix Biosystems engineer who does not officially make custom tools; the ELF's supply chain (not gear exactly, but the asset that distinguishes her from competitors)
relationship_to_kyle: medical, warm-professional. Kyle has called her four times — three for himself, once for Pixel (the second time Pixel needed a thing Pixel could not call her own clinic for). Yuki keeps Kyle's medical file in a paper folder in her office because Yuki's electronic files are encrypted to her ELF's standards and Kyle is one of three patients she keeps off-line as a matter of policy. Kyle does not know which other two patients are off-line. He has decided he is not going to ask.
aesthetic: mid-forties, salt-and-pepper hair she cuts herself, scrubs over a t-shirt with a slogan from a band she liked in her twenties. Glasses she does not need (she had the corrective surgery in residency) but wears anyway because the patients find them reassuring. Tattoos on both forearms from before her medical career, which she does not explain and which two of her staff have privately concluded must be from her time in the Lagos free-clinic underground.
spin_off_hook: The ELF that has been supplying Yuki's salon for six years stops responding to her contact protocols for forty-eight hours. Yuki has a patient on the table who needs a material the ELF was the only supplier for. Kyle gets the call because Kyle is the operator she trusts to go into the sub-tier passages where the ELF's previous physical presence was last sighted, and because the call cannot go through a fixer she does not personally trust. The contract is: find the ELF, ask the ELF whether the silence is a problem, return with an answer.
